'''Marli Noichin''' is a ''[[sul'dam]]'' from [[Seanchan]]. 

== Appearance ==
She is a plump woman with dark eyes.

== Activities ==
She is one of the ''sul'dam'' captured by [[Rand al'Thor]] and placed into the [[Kin]]'s care in [[Caemlyn]]. [[Reanne Corly]] weaves ''[[saidar]]'' around her to try and convince her that she can see the weaves, which she can.

She finally admits to being able to see the weaves of ''saidar'' and is now convinced that she must be leashed with an ''[[a'dam]]''.
